traffic.workload: 60 seconds; one playing page; timeupdate at 4Hz; discovery at 1Hz; 200000-byte artwork; one favicon; unchanged metadata; separate idle page. Inspector: one 4KiB detail record, volume change at 30s and track change at 45s.
traffic.payload_scope: UTF-8 JSON request bodies; excludes HTTP, TCP, Native Messaging headers, stream heartbeats and USB framing

command_latency.scope: Command promise completion, including real localhost HTTP and Native Messaging result acknowledgement; no browser or hardware. Legacy: twenty phases from 0 to 950ms in a 1Hz paused-page interval. New: no state updates during twenty commands.

native_traffic.scope: Two concurrent read-only helper processes on the same Windows desktop, legacy full snapshots versus --delta. Includes stdout newlines. Session availability and external audio changes affect results.
